description: This file defines TypeScript types, classes, and interfaces for the 'dispatcher' module used in the 'undici' HTTP client library. It includes the core Dispatcher class, related types, event handling, and request options.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Core class that manages HTTP request dispatching, connection management, and event handling within the 'undici' library.

methods.name: dispatch (options: Dispatcher.DispatchOptions, handler: Dispatcher.DispatchHandler): boolean dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an HTTP request based on provided options and handler.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a two-way communication with a resource.

methods.name: compose
methods.description: Creates a composed dispatcher from multiple interceptors.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request and returns a promise with the response data.

methods.name: pipeline
methods.description: Sets up a stream pipeline for requests.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a faster streaming request method.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades the connection to a different protocol.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the client gracefully, waiting for pending requests to complete.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Abruptly destroys the client, aborting pending requests.

ctags.name: UndiciHeaders
ctags.pattern: /^export type UndiciHeaders = Record<string, string | string[]> | IncomingHttpHeaders | string[] |/
